acceptance.given: A supplied FAQ entry has no declared stable error ID or decision-branch path.

oracle.expected: The validator reports a deterministic failure identifying the orphan FAQ entry, and the orphan case is rejected.
forbidden: An orphan FAQ entry passes validation.
oracle.observable: Validator result or CLI output during FAQ reachability validation, evaluated by the targeted package-validation test.

acceptance.when: Run the FAQ reachability validator against a package containing the supplied orphan FAQ entry and inspect its validation result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Target the existing package-validation test entry that exercises validator rejection behavior in .agents/skills/run-refactor-implementation-acceptance/tests/test_package.py.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or refine deterministic FAQ reachability validation so supplied orphan FAQ entries without a stable error ID or decision-branch path are rejected.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; reverting restores the prior package-validation behavior without data or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: FAQ package input transitions from containing an unreachable supplied entry to a rejected validation result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted pytest invocation completes with the orphan FAQ case asserting a non-passing validation result.
